Doctor: Could you share your current blood pressure readings and how frequently you monitor it? Additionally, have there been any recent changes in your hypertension management or treatment plan? Patient: I've been using the blood pressure cuff once a day, and my readings have been pretty normal. There haven't been any changes in my hypertension management or treatment plan recently.
